<!--
PR title: Conventional Commits, same as a commit.
e.g. feat(auth): allow password reset from the mobile client
-->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new functionality
- [ ] `fix` — defect correction
- [ ] `refactor` / `chore` / `docs` / `ci` — no behavior change

## What this PR does

<!-- Which problem it solves and why this way. Not which lines changed: that is
     in the diff. If a decision is not obvious, say why it was taken. -->

## How it was tested

<!-- Tests added, commands run with their result, or manual steps.
     And what is NOT covered, if anything was left out. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `composer lint`, `composer test:types` and `composer test` are green, in that order
- [ ] There are tests for what I changed, mirroring the source layout
- [ ] Coverage and type coverage stay at 100%
- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits
- [ ] The PR delivers one thing and is reviewable in one sitting
- [ ] Nothing added is specific to a client, a business domain or my machine
